Most short [[Widget loops|widget loops]] fall into a handful of recurring backbone shapes, each a [[Canonical loop|canonical loop]], so a loop's length and sequence go a long way towards fixing its structure. The evidence in the vault comes from one crystal survey, and solution dynamics suggest the shapes are populations rather than fixed states, as [[Widget loop shapes interconvert in solution|the claim on interconversion]] describes.

## Evidence

### [[alpha2020|Alpha (2020): survey of 400 crystal structures]]

A survey of 400 crystal structures assigned most short loops to five shapes. It is the only direct census in the vault.

### [[gamma2021|Gamma (2021): simulations of loops in solution]]

Simulations recover the same shapes but show loops switching between them, so a shape describes a population.
